main_text.l: quiorum Dei, & lac verbi Dei gusta.
Nam ut ex Cypriano addisci potest, ob-
tinuit in ecclesia, iam a tempore Apo-
habitae, ut infunderetur super ipsos Spiri-
tus sanctus. Vide de hoc ritu Aposto-
hunc modum: si qui post baptismalem
rum Spiritus sancti participes: si qui
tutes futuri seculi gustarunt, lapsi, ad resipis-

page.notes: Catchword "resipis-" appears at the right foot of the last line; the text is a hyphenated continuation and is kept in the paragraph. Page is a mid-book text page with no marginal notes.
